subject: Request: Conditional no-PO onboarding — evidence & approval tiers
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Patel <samira@astrascale.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@astrascale.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Conditional no-PO onboarding — evidence & approval tiers

Hi Samira,

Thanks again for the intro call this morning. AstraScale looks like a great fit for our pilot program — excited to get you running on Redwood. Procurement asked me to surface our standard onboarding requirements and propose a path if you need to start without a PO in place.

Quick summary of what I can do today:
- Attach our vendor onboarding form for completion (vendor_onboarding_form.pdf).
- Propose a conditional no-PO pilot for the first 90 days for low-dollar usage under a defined threshold (details below).
- Provide an evidence checklist we need from your side to accept an exception (SOC2, billing contact, invoice routing, authorized approver).

If AstraScale is asking to delay the PO because of your internal subscription-billing cadence, we can be flexible but have to limit exposure. Proposed temporary terms:
- No-PO pilot allowed for first 90 days if monthly spend will be under $5k and invoices are routed to procurement@astrascale.com and finance@astrascale.com.
- AstraScale signs the onboarding form and gives a named approver who can sign the subsequent PO within 90 days.
- Redwood will require SOC 2 Type II summary and a payment method on file (procurement card or ACH with supplier form).

Can you confirm if those constraints would work for you? If so I’ll route this to Procurement and copy Legal for a short DocuSign approval so we can start ingesting usage.

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0149

> Hi Jordan — quick note before the call: our Procurement team typically requires a PO for any vendor, but the billing system we use batches subscriptions monthly and generating a PO for a short pilot is slow.
> 
> Would Redwood consider a limited exception while we validate the POC (30–90 days)? I can loop in Ben (CFO) and Procurement to agree thresholds.
> 
> I’ll attach our SOW so you can see expected spend profile.
> 
> —Samira
From: Samira Patel <samira@astrascale.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Lyons <ben.lyons@astrascale.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@astrascale.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Conditional no-PO onboarding — evidence & approval tiers

Jordan —

Thanks for the detailed proposal and the onboarding form. I’ve shared the form and your pilot suggestion with our procurement team and Ben. A couple of clarifying questions from Procurement:

1) What is Redwood’s policy for spend aggregation? If we have multiple teams on the pilot, do you enforce PO per business unit or per legal entity?
2) What evidence exactly do you need for a no-PO exception — we can provide SOC 2 summary but need to know whether you need a full attestation or just a vendor summary.
3) If we agree to a temporary card on file for the first invoice, what refund/chargeback protections are in place?

Attached is our SOW (astrascale_sow_v1.pdf) and a rough monthly usage estimate. If helpful, I can do a short procurement-only call tomorrow to speed alignment.

Best,
Samira Patel
Head of Partnerships, AstraScale
samira@astrascale.com

Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Conditional no-PO onboarding — evidence & approval tiers

Jordan / Laura —

Saw the thread with AstraScale. We can support a conditional exception but want a clear, auditable matrix so Finance can approve consistently. Draft proposal below (we should make this short and operational):

Exception tiering (proposed):
- Tier A (auto-approve): Monthly spend <= $1,000 AND vendor completed onboarding form AND vendor has SOC2 summary on file. Approval authority: Revenue Ops Manager.
- Tier B (requires Finance sign-off): Monthly spend > $1,000 and <= $5,000, plus onboarding form, SOC2 summary, named approver, and invoice routing. Approval authority: Procurement Lead.
- Tier C (requires Director approval & Legal sign-off): Monthly spend > $5,000 or multi-entity aggregation > $10,000.

Additional controls:
- Timebox the exception to 90 days with automatic PO generation reminder at day 60.
- Require procurement email alias on invoices and a payment method on file for the first invoice only.
- Maintain a CSV log of exceptions with supporting evidence uploaded to our procurement SharePoint (link in related_links).

Jordan — if AstraScale confirms they’ll stay under $5k and provide SOC2 summary, I think Procurement Lead can sign off quickly (Tier B). I’ll draft the checkbox checklist (po-exception-checklist.xlsx) and route to the procurement alias for signature.

—Karthik
Senior Manager, Procurement Governance | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: Request: Conditional no-PO onboarding — evidence & approval tiers

Samira —

Thanks for the quick replies and for sending the SOW. We ran this through Procurement and agreed on a conditional approach that should let you start the pilot while keeping both parties protected. Summary of approved path (final):

- Approved exception: Tier B conditional no-PO pilot (monthly spend cap $5,000) for up to 90 days.
- Required from AstraScale before onboarding: completed vendor_onboarding_form.pdf; SOC2 Type II summary or equivalent security attestation; named approver & procurement alias (procurement@astrascale.com); invoice routing to procurement and finance; payment method for first invoice.
- Controls: exception expires automatically after 90 days. On day 60 we’ll send a PO reminder and attach a DocuSign request to formalize the PO if spend approaches threshold.

I’ve attached the signed exception approval and the checklist (exception-approval-signed.pdf, po-exception-checklist.xlsx). Please confirm receipt and we’ll kick off technical onboarding with Solutions Engineering. If Ben wants to jump on a 15-minute call to confirm the payment protection details (refunds/chargebacks) I can make time early next week.

Appreciate you moving quickly on the onboarding form — once we have that we’ll create the account and start the trial.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0149
